name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B
definition: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B is an open-weight Nemotron 3.5 model by NVIDIA focused on customization, autonomous agents, long context and efficient server/local AI deployments.

architecture.context: Up to 1M; NVIDIA validates 256K on a single H100 and 1M on larger supported configurations

license.name: OpenMDW 1.1
license.commercial_use: Review exact official terms before production.

hardware.summary: High-memory workstation/server class. NVIDIA documents single H100/A100 BF16 serving and optimized NVFP4 variants for broader deployment.

deployment.summary: NVIDIA documents vLLM and SGLang for BF16, with optimized NVFP4 checkpoints for production inference.
deployment.eu_eea_self_hosting: Technically possible when the complete stack is operated on EU/EEA infrastructure.
deployment.data_residency: Provider origin does not determine data residency.
